$comment: What every frame may update to: the input of the update decision
(docs/auto-updates.md). Frames, backends and the cloud read THIS file on
update-manifest.json (the cloud mirrors it at /api/updates/manifest), so a
merge to main is how a release is blocked, paused or made a stepping stone.
The release workflow appends each release here when it publishes it.
releases[]: version (YYYY.M.N), at (ISO time the rollout starts),
pausedAt? (the rollout stays at the percent it had then),
blocked? (a reason: offered to no frame), blockedTargets? ({"platform/target
pattern": reason}), targets? (allow-list of patterns), minFrom? (the oldest
version that may install it directly), steppingStone? (every newer release
paused: a reason stops every automatic update (manual ones too).
A pattern is "<platform>/<target>" (linux | esp32 | pico), exact or ending in *.
